name: Kitchen Sync: Aloha!
source: A cozy, story-driven cooking RPG set in Hawaii. Become head chef of your family's restaurant, build a team of passionate chefs, and dish up tasty Hawaiian food. Manage your kitchens, build friendships, find romance, explore the island’s tropical spots, and discover the power of cooking together.
translation: 一款以夏威夷为背景的舒适、故事驱动的烹饪角色扮演游戏。成为你家庭餐厅的主厨，组建一支充满热情的厨师团队，烹制美味的夏威夷美食。管理你的厨房，建立友谊，寻找浪漫，探索岛上的热带景点，并一起发现烹饪的力量。
